Engine showcase
===============

Start: double-click showcase.exe (Windows) or run ./showcase (Linux, macOS), with the `assets`
folder kept next to it. On macOS the build is unsigned: the first time, right-click showcase,
choose Open and confirm (or run `xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine .` in the unzipped folder). The first start takes a while: the valley, planet and trees are
generated on the way in. A console window shows the log; keep it open, it closes with the game.

Needs a GPU with Vulkan, DirectX 12 or Metal (Apple silicon or a recent Intel Mac). All zones together use a lot of memory (16 GB of RAM
recommended); with less, load only some zones with --zones (below).

Flying camera (on at start)
  Right mouse (hold)   look around
  W A S D              move
  Space / Ctrl         up / down
  Shift                faster
  Mouse wheel          change speed (speed also grows with height, so orbit is reachable)
  1 - 9                jump to a zone
  0                    overview of the valley
  O                    orbit
  [ and ]              hour of the day back / forward
  T                    start or stop the clock

Play mode
  P                    toggle play mode: a character appears in front of the camera
  W A S D, mouse       run and look
  Space                jump (twice for a double jump; jump at walls to wall-run)
  Shift                sprint
  Ctrl                 crouch and slide
  Q                    dash
  F                    grapple
  Left / right mouse   attack / block
  Middle mouse         lock on to the nearest enemy
  E                    interact
  Tab                  inventory
  M                    map
  Esc                  pause menu

A gamepad works too (A jump, B crouch, X interact, triggers attack and block).

F3 shows a performance panel (fps, frame-time graph, GPU time per pass, memory) in either mode.

Command-line options
  --size 2560x1440     window size
  --quality low        low, medium, high (default) or ultra: resolution, shadows, view
                       distance, detail density and effects
  --profile            time every system: the F3 panel lists the slowest, and every 5 s the
                       game writes engine-profile.txt next to where it was started
  --zones arena,lake   load only these zones' demos (faster start, less memory); `all` is the
                       default. Zones: plaza market paddock physics yard magic gallery2d forest
                       meadow lake water footsteps tracks cave arena parkour fortress voxel
                       field range weather track airfield spaceport
  Windows: make a shortcut to showcase.exe and add the options after the path in its Target.

THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md lists the licenses and authors of the art and sounds in `assets`.
